thread:
Dana: heads-up — console dashboard charts super slow for a lot of users after yesterday's telemetry rollout. heatmap/usage charts hang on 'loading' and then jump, frame drops.
Ben: seen it, repro on prod-canary. worker CPU spikes and lots of repeated network requests for the same tile.
Evelyn: FYI the telemetry sampler change added `X-Route-Context: account_id` header to routed requests. could affect routing/prefetch policy.
Carlos: digging into KVCACHE logs: hit rate plunged from 92% -> 3% after the rollout. keys now include user id suffix. that explains thundering repeated fetches.
Dana: ohhh — the prefetch code added user context to keys for analytics last week, didn't think of cache semantics.
Frank: quick candidate patch: strip user id from tile keys for org-scoped charts. small change in `src/ui/kvcache/keyBuilder.ts`:
```ts
// old
return `${query}:${userId}`
// new
return `${query}`
```
Ben: we can't blindly remove userId everywhere — some tiles are user-scoped. need to ensure org vs user scope is explicit.
Carlos: confirmed these affected charts are org-scoped (metrics by org). safe to remove userId there. for user-scoped charts we keep the userId.
Evelyn: also noticed the telemetry sampler flip set `prefetch=true` on routed heatmap requests, so we're doing prefetch + client fetch for same payload -> double work.
Frank: I'll add guard to only set `prefetch=true` when route policy = 'prefetch-only' and add a feature-flag.
Dana: action plan for hotfix: 1) revert vizkit bump (there's a ~200KB bundle increase in 4.7.0), 2) kvcache key change for org-scoped tiles, 3) revert telemetry prefetch toggle. anyone volunteer to cut the branch and coordinate canary?
Ben: I can help with canary deploy and smoke tests. will also run flame graphs on worker.
Carlos: I'll run cache/regression evals against our sample orgs and confirm no cross-org leakage. ETA 30m.
Evelyn: I'll check routing quota impact (we might have seen quota noise due to double-fetch).
Dana: I'll cut the hotfix branch now `hotfix/console-prefetch-kv-1719009999` and open PR. tagging you all.
Frank: PR here: https://git.internal/r/redwood/console/pulls/842 — small diff, unit tests added for keyBuilder.
Ben: deploying canary now (10%). will monitor latency, error-rate, and kv hit rate.
deploy-bot: canary deploy started: console/hotfix-1719009999 -> env=prod-canary, percent=10
infra-bot: infra metrics: routing QPS stable, no quota breaches in last 5m.
Carlos: initial cache hit rate jumped back to 88% within 5 minutes on canary. memory usage stable.
Ben: canary looks good on latency and heatmap load time improved ~65% for canary users. rolling to 50%. :thumbsup:
Dana: thanks all — once we hit 100% I'll roll vizkit revert into main and follow up with a plan to lazy-load vizkit for less-used panels to avoid bundle bloat.
Ben: note: create a follow-up ticket to audit any other cache key changes in recent PRs.
Evelyn: filed ENG-3124 for routing/prefetch audit.
Frank: leaving a TODO to add telemetry tests that assert prefetch flag behavior in integration tests.
Dana: closing thread; will post postmortem if anything else pops. :white_check_mark:
